text: {"lessons":["My account rose while I repeatedly sold winning shares, but that does not show those sales improved returns; I should base trades on a consistent plan, not on gains since purchase.","Avoiding sales of losing positions can keep me tied to past decisions; I should reassess each stock on its future prospects rather than treating it as a separate account.","Recent price moves do not predict future returns, so I should avoid reacting to short-term changes and keep a diversified portfolio aligned with my goals."]}
